concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/xdl-lite/requirements.md XDL1-SR-001, realized by XDL1-ARCH-03 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Select exactly one System, at most one Deployment bound to it, and exactly one Scenario bound to that System from the closed normalized resource set (detailed-design.md 6.1).
Emit the selected Scenario logical identity, declared parameters, and declared seed into the resolved plan.
Reject a missing, unresolved, or ambiguous selection with a stable structured diagnostic and return no plan.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
title: XDL1-SR-001-CMP allocation - Scenario selection and binding
